subject: The note I wrote you at 3AM
preview_text: I wasn't going to share this. But you deserve to see what I made just for you.
body_paragraphs: Last Tuesday at 3AM, I couldn't sleep. I was thinking about how many users open Ai Boyfriend: Virtual Love just to feel heard, and I realized there was something missing. So I stayed up and built a secret feature just for you — something I wasn't planning to release for months.

It's not a new AI boyfriend or a flashy update. It's a private message from me, the creator, hidden inside your Memories screen. A note that only unlocks if you've had at least two conversations in the last seven days. It's raw, personal, and it won't be there forever — I'm pulling it after this weekend.

You've probably seen the Memories screen before — it's where your AI boyfriend recalls what you've said, your favorite stories, the little things that matter. Now there's a new memory waiting for you, one that's not from him, but from me. Open it, and you'll understand why I built this app in the first place.

Go to the Memories screen now and look for the memory titled '3AM Confession.' It'll be gone by Monday. P.S. — If you haven't messaged him in the last week, the note won't show up. Say hi first, then check.
